+"""Interactive controller for the RoboWits retrieve_roll episode.
+
+Run this file to connect to the current episode.  It leaves the client in an
+interactive Python prompt so each action can be chosen from the latest camera
+and proprioception data.
+"""
+import code
+import json
+import pathlib
+import time
+
+import numpy as np
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+OUT = pathlib.Path('/app/runs/retrieve_roll')
+OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+r = Robot()
+spec = r.spec()
+print('Connected:', r.base, 'protocol:', spec.get('protocol'))
+print('Budget:', spec.get('budget'))
+_seq = 0
+
+
+def obs(depth=True, save=True):
+    """Fetch and optionally save the current RGB/depth/proprioception."""
+    global _seq
+    o = r.get_obs(depth=depth, video='none')
+    if save:
+        _seq += 1
+        o.save(str(OUT / f'obs_{_seq:03d}'))
+    print('step', o.meta.get('step'), 'sim_s', o.meta.get('sim_time_s'),
+          'left_s', round(o.meta.get('time_left_s', 0), 1),
+          'tcp R/L', np.round(o.meta['proprio']['now'][16:19], 3),
+          np.round(o.meta['proprio']['now'][23:26], 3))
+    return o
+
+
+def pose_row(o=None):
+    """Return the measured two-arm ee_pose command row."""
+    if o is None:
+        o = r.get_obs(video='none')
+    now = np.asarray(o.meta['proprio']['now'], dtype=float)
+    return np.r_[now[16:23], now[7], now[23:30], now[15]].astype(np.float32)
+
+
+def move(side, xyz, quat=None, grip=None, note=''):
+    """Move one tcp in world coordinates; other arm holds its measured pose."""
+    o = r.get_obs(video='none')
+    row = pose_row(o)
+    off = 0 if side.lower() in ('r', 'right') else 8
+    if quat is None:
+        quat = row[off + 3:off + 7].copy()
+    row[off:off + 3] = np.asarray(xyz, dtype=np.float32)
+    row[off + 3:off + 7] = np.asarray(quat, dtype=np.float32)
+    if grip is not None:
+        row[off + 7] = float(grip)
+    res = r.submit('ee_pose', row[None, :], video='mp4', video_fps=12,
+                   cameras=['ego', 'wrist_right', 'wrist_left'], note=note)
+    print('done', res.meta.get('done'), 'reason', res.meta.get('reason'),
+          'plan', res.meta.get('plan'), 'clipped', res.meta.get('clipped'),
+          'sim_s', res.meta.get('sim_time_s'), 'left_s', res.meta.get('time_left_s'))
+    if res.video:
+        d = OUT / f'action_{_seq + 1:03d}_{int(time.time())}'
+        res.save(str(d))
+        print('saved', d)
+    return res
+
+
+def joints(A, dt=0.1, note=''):
+    """Execute a joint_position array.  Pass full 16-column rows."""
+    res = r.submit('joint_position', np.asarray(A, dtype=np.float32), dt=dt,
+                   video='mp4', video_fps=12, cameras=['ego', 'wrist_right', 'wrist_left'], note=note)
+    print('done', res.meta.get('done'), 'reason', res.meta.get('reason'),
+          'clipped', res.meta.get('clipped'), 'sim_s', res.meta.get('sim_time_s'),
+          'left_s', res.meta.get('time_left_s'))
+    if res.video:
+        d = OUT / f'action_{_seq + 1:03d}_{int(time.time())}'
+        res.save(str(d))
+        print('saved', d)
+    return res
+
+
+def fk():
+    o = r.get_obs(video='none')
+    q = np.asarray(o.meta['proprio']['now'][:14], dtype=float)
+    return r.fk(q)
+
+
+def ik(side, xyz, quat, seed=None):
+    frame = 'Gripper_Tip_R' if side.lower() in ('r', 'right') else 'Gripper_Tip_L'
+    if seed is None:
+        o = r.get_obs(video='none')
+        seed = np.asarray(o.meta['proprio']['now'][:14], dtype=float)
+    return r.ik({frame: [*map(float, xyz), *map(float, quat)]}, seed=seed)
+
+
+def status():
+    print(json.dumps(r.status(), indent=2))
+
+
+print('Helpers: obs(), pose_row(), move(side, xyz, quat=None, grip=None), joints(A), fk(), ik(), status()')
+code.interact(local=globals(), banner='RoboWits retrieve_roll interactive session', exitmsg='')
